form:FormGroup.label: User ID
form:FormGroup.helpText: The name the user signs in with. Must be unique.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Used to sign in. Must be unique.

form:FormGroup.label: Email
form:FormGroup.helpText: Optional. Used to send password reset emails, so it must not be used by another account.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Must not be used by another account. Used for password resets.

form:FormGroup.label: Comments
form:FormGroup.helpText: Optional notes about the account, for administrators.

form:FormGroup.label: Never Deactivate When Unused
form:FormGroup.helpText: Tick to stop the account being marked inactive when it goes unused. Accounts that are never used, or not signed in to for a set time, are otherwise deactivated automatically.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Stops the account being deactivated when unused.

form:FormGroup.label: Enabled
form:FormGroup.helpText: Untick to stop the user signing in.

form:FormGroup.label: Sign-in lock
form:FormGroup.helpText: Shows whether the account is locked after repeated failed sign-ins. Select Unlock to clear the lock and the failed sign-in count.

form:FormGroup.label: Activity
form:FormGroup.helpText: Shows whether the account has been made inactive because it was not used. Select Reactivate to let the user sign in again.
